about: CONTRABASS CLARINET: made from scratch by tools/studio_export/new_models/contrabass_clarinet.py (no Pixel Pitch module has the instrument), centred on its bounding box and scaled to fit a unit sphere

fields.P: the face's vertices, k x 3 (x, y, z; y up), in drawing order (a fan from the first vertex)
fields.emit: its colour is used as it is, unshaded
fields.gid: group id: 1 marks the ground group, anything else is the instrument

name: CONTRABASS CLARINET
note: faces are in the order the builder made them; the sprite renderer draws them in this order
